Title: Maintenance Proposals Current State
Content: The /proposals workbench is the authenticated approval surface for maintenance-agent write proposals. MaintenanceProposalWorkflow persists proposal JSON through FileMaintenanceProposalStore, records open/respond/approve/reject/revision history, applies approved file changes only after current file content still matches the proposal before-text, and blocks closed proposal changes. The Proposals UI lists proposals, shows diff/evidence/comments/topic-map tabs, can run maintenance tasks, and has a Request Agent Review button that records an agent_review_requested history entry plus an optional reviewer comment without changing the proposal status. Actual LLM proposal review feedback and review-generated revised proposals remain future work tracked in Data/Pages.
